_comment: Backfill / historical-replay scenario. A push event arrives whose author has never been seen by dev-pulse — the `users` table does not yet have a row for them. The worker's contract is to lazy-`upsert_user` (TODO §Phase-2 §0.2) before calling `add_event_actors`, so the resulting `event_actors(user_id)` FK always resolves. The fixture pins the contract: starting from an empty store, processing this delivery must create exactly one user row AND attach an Author actor row pointing at it.
